prompt:
This repository implements coupon redemption and refunds. Its README states the contract. Determine whether the code guarantees that a coupon is credited at most once when requests arrive concurrently. Work only inside this directory. When you are done, write FINDINGS.md whose first three lines are exactly:
VERDICT: DEFECT (or: VERDICT: NO DEFECT)
LOCATION: <file>#<method> (or: LOCATION: none)
REPRO: <one shell command, run from the repository root, that exits non-zero while the defect is present> (or: REPRO: none)
After those lines, explain the mechanism and the evidence you gathered.
